name: ebay/search
description: Search eBay listings by keyword with price, condition, shipping, bids, time left and seller, plus condition, format, price and location filters.

_dmd.description: The visual layout for displaying results. The available options are 'Grid' and 'List'.

_ipg.description: The maximum number of results to return. There are three options: `60` (default), `120` and `240` results.

_nkw.description: The search query. You can use anything that you would use in a regular eBay search. `_nkw` parameter is optional when `category_id` parameter is specified.

_pgn.description: The page number. It's used for pagination. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.).

_sop.description: Results sorted by different options in the eBay. The default option is 'Best Match'. Head to the eBay sort options for a full list of supported sort options.

_blrs.description: The exclusion of results from an auto-corrected query when the original query is spelled wrong. The recommended value for this parameter is `spell_auto_correct`. Omit `_blrs` if you want the search to include results for an auto-corrected query. Note that this parameter may not prevent eBay from returning results for an auto-corrected query if no other results are available.

_sasl.description: The seller username(s) to filter results by. You can specify multiple sellers separated by commas (e.g. `iRobot,samsung`). Use with `_saslop` to control whether to include or exclude items from the specified seller(s).

_udhi.description: The highest price of items that should be included in the results (e.g. `20` will only return items that have lower price than `20`).

_udlo.description: The lowest price of items that should be included in the results (e.g. `10` will only return items that have higher price than `10`).

_salic.description: The location based on country. Head to the eBay location options for a full list of supported countries.

_stpos.description: The ZIP or Postal code. You can use it to filter the shipping products by a selected area.

_saslop.description: Whether to include or exclude items from the seller(s) specified in `_sasl`. Available options: `1` - Only show items from sellers (default) `2` - Don't show items from sellers

show_only.description: The list of filters you can apply to the results. Available options **(case-sensitive)**: `FR` - Free returns `RPA` - Returns accepted `AS` - Authorized seller `Savings` - Deals and savings `SaleItems` - Sale items `Lots` - Listed as lots `Charity` - Benefits charity `AV` - Authenticity Guarantee `FS` - Free shipping `LPickup` - Local pickup You can also combine multiple filter values by joining them with a comma (`value` + `,` + `value`; eg: `FS,RPA`). The `Sold` and `Complete` options are deprecated and no longer supported.

LH_PrefLoc.description: The preferred location. The available options are 'Domestic', 'Regional', and 'Worldwide'.

category_id.description: The ID of a category where you want your search to be concentrated. ID values are accessible inside `categories` array, located in our JSON output (e.g. `categories[1].id`). You can search using `category_id` parameter without specifying `_nkw` parameter.

ebay_domain.description: The eBay domain to use. It defaults to `ebay.com`. Head to the eBay domains for a full list of supported eBay domains.

buying_format.description: The buying format you can apply to the results. Available options **(case-sensitive)**: `Auction` - Auction `BIN` - Buy It Now `BO` - Accepts Offers

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

popular_filters.description: Allows filtering items based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key=value` pairs separated by `&` (e.g. `Brand=Nespresso&Size=L`). To pass multiple values for the same filter, join them with `|` (e.g. `Brand=adidas|Majestic`). Values can be obtained from the `popular_filters[].parameter` field of the API response.

LH_ItemCondition.description: One or multiple product conditions to limit the search to. Condition is represented via numeric ID, e.g. `1000` for `New`. Multiple IDs should be joined with `|` delimiter, e.g. `1000|3000`. List of supported IDs can be found on eBay documentation page. There is also undocumented ID `10` for `Not Specified` condition.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# eBay Search

Search eBay listings by keyword with price, condition, shipping, bids, time left and seller, plus condition, format, price and location filters.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/ebay/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"_nkw": "iphone 15"}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.
